review_independence: The reviewer authored no reviewed production runtime, integration, example or document source and invoked no Cargo build. It independently reviewed actual source and retained compilation/link artifacts emitted by the coordinator.
scope: Corrected v2 runtime source and frozen HAL integration retain the original independent static approval. This extension independently inspects actual retained results for all 43 frozen main ARM rows, preserving the failed M24 attempt and the exact one-line example manifest source transition. Clean acceptance and final source packaging remain separate.

baseline_reference.basis: Recorded before-file hashes and actual frozen baseline copies; this review does not claim a separate Git HEAD check.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial counter_clear_overflow invoked Icr::write_noop unconditionally, but both actual buffered ATIM PACs lack that helper.
resolved_findings.resolution: The v2 source cfg-selects classic write_noop and buffered existing Registers::FLAGS=0x00ff3fff, then clears typed UIF only. Only this runtime file changed between v1 and v2; no PAC or register-write-policy change was required.

resolved_findings.finding: The copied 54-package lock graph was not reachable from the initial new example root feature declarations; initial M24 failed Cargo --locked validation with exit101 before compilation.
resolved_findings.resolution: An independently reviewed local time-driver forwarding feature restores the original reachable graph. The lock remains byte-identical, dependency versions/revisions/checksums and exact M24/M29 CLI feature tuples are unchanged. Exact frozen M24 retry and all M24-M43 commands pass.

checks.name: shared_state_and_inactive_irq
checks.finding: State contains only static active/elapsed cells and AtomicWaker. The handler checks active before any selected-bank MMIO, requires enabled source and positively observed flag, selectively acknowledges that bank, sets elapsed, and wakes outside the critical section. There is no owner/future pointer or shared-vector state.

checks.name: per_bank_and_shared_vector_identity
checks.finding: Each BTIM/GTIM/ATIM macro implementation returns one local static for its exact bank. L012 GTIM3 and GTIM4 remain separate statics with the common GTIM34 associated interrupt. No per-owner path disables, unpends or reprioritizes the vector.

checks.name: minimal_register_boundary
checks.finding: CounterRegisters adds exactly enabled/read and bool-set request operations. Existing actual PAC engines implement them with classic GTIM OV/IER, buffered GTIM UIF/IER, classic ATIM UIF/CR.UIE, L010 ATIM UIF/IER and L012 ATIM UIF/DIER. BTIM keeps its per-IP request registers.

checks.name: selective_r1w0
checks.finding: Consumption uses typed positive flag reads and own no-op masks. Classic GTIM mask 0x3ff preserves reserved bits7/8; classic ATIM mask 0x7ffff preserves reserved bit1. Buffered GTIM uses its 0x00f01e5f no-op; corrected buffered ATIM uses existing FLAGS 0x00ff3fff. Selective clears change only their intended flag; no ISR writes or ICR reads/RMW are introduced.

checks.name: acquisition_and_forget_retirement
checks.finding: Common initialization retires active/elapsed without MMIO before RCC reset in the same critical section, then initializes requests masked. Pure configuration failures occur before acquisition. Async publication clears hardware/software indication, enables its request, sets active and only then enables the NVIC vector. Forgotten ownership cannot retain ISR access through successful reconstruction.

checks.name: all_constructor_routes
checks.finding: Blocking/Async Timer, SimplePwm including new3, old capture/Qei, buffered complementary, and native capture/QEI join Timer::new_configured/new_inner. The direct classic complementary bypass explicitly retires state after validation and before RCC. BTIM trigger/cascade and ADC-trigger ownership retain the existing Timer path and destination-detach-before-UG ordering.

checks.name: wait_take_discard_and_cancellation
checks.finding: wait_overflow registers before take. take combines and retires retained state with positively observed hardware in one critical section, including Blocking owners. clear_overflow explicitly discards both indications. Cancelling/forgetting a wait has no destructor-based hardware mutation; a later wait replaces the static waker.

checks.name: normal_and_reconfiguration_operations
checks.finding: Counter start/stop preserve requests, CNT and event state. set_counter validates ARR first. Frequency/period validation precedes mutation; apply_timing saves/masks only overflow enable, clears retained indication, performs the selected stop/reset/latch/selective-clear/restart sequence, restores enable and only then publishes timing. Classic GTIM gains no invented UG.

checks.name: classic_command_safe_cr
checks.finding: Classic start/stop include prior UIE in fresh known counter CR. The UIE setter reconstructs all defined non-command fields and omits TG/UG/BG. Existing PWM control reads also pass through this command-safe function. Deliberate update alone sets UG while temporarily clearing URS, restores intended control and retires synthetic UIF before overflow enable restoration.

checks.name: drop_and_rcc_policy
checks.finding: Timer Drop retires active/elapsed, masks bank requests, stops and applies the existing gate policy in one critical section. Direct classic complementary Drop also retires first. Existing BTIM shared gate/reset behavior and RCC read-barrier semantics remain intact; no checked reset-success guarantee is added.

checks.name: native_api_and_pins
checks.finding: Six sealed native half markers and separate native instance/input pin traits are cfg-qualified. Native ATIM is not granted four-channel InputInstance or CH4 input. Whole-timer and GPIO ownership have no public split/free/mutable-inner escape. Optional capture inputs and mandatory independent CH1A/CH1B QEI pins retain their exact type roles.

checks.name: native_capture_construction
checks.finding: Capture validates clock and requested tick ceiling before common construction, scans only the actual classic /1,/2,/4,/8,/16,/32,/64,/256 subset, installs ARR65535 and starts through native control with all six BKS fields zero. Omitted-half operations check ownership before MMIO; is_enabled returns false. Input wrappers disconnect through Flex on error/drop.

checks.name: native_capture_pair_and_flags
checks.finding: Per-half edge/filter changes temporarily set only that half BKS to zero, retain the peer intended BKS, update only that filter and restore intended pair state with fresh CHxCR writes that cannot replay CCGA/CCGB. CCR reads acknowledge neither F nor E; each clear changes exactly the requested typed flag. No counter or peer flag mutation is introduced.

checks.name: native_capture_en_independent_cleanup
checks.finding: Capture Drop zeros all six BKS acceptance fields while the bank is live before native EN stop, pin disconnection and inner Timer gating. The implementation does not rely on EN=0 alone to suppress capture.

checks.name: native_qei_sequence_and_bounds
checks.finding: QEI rejects ARR0 before GPIO/timer mutation, fixes /1 CT0 MODE2, retains CSA/CSB input interpretation with all BKS0, selects direct IA1S/IB1S and SMS4/5/6, configures native filter/inversion, then performs EN followed by CNT0 followed by one selective UIF/OVF/UNDF clear. It exposes raw direction and modulo count, with immutable configuration and no start/stop API.

checks.name: native_qei_flags_and_drop
checks.finding: QEI wrap APIs observe/clear OVF and UNDF separately and never substitute inner UIF. Drop stops native EN, disconnects SMS, zeros all BKS, disconnects both pins and then lets Timer retire/mask/gate. BKS0 plus SMS decoding remains the approved source composition, not a silicon result.

checks.name: hal_generated_admission
checks.finding: HAL matches the exact ClassicPairedV1 enum, ATIM name/kind/Atim block and approved actual classic version before cfg/trait emission. CAP1A/B through CAP3A/B emit only native input traits after retained safe-pin and package checks. timer_overflow_irq validates GLOBAL name, number and exact owners, allowing only L012 GTIM3/4 shared membership. Reserved GTIM exclusion precedes instance and pin emission.

checks.name: counter_example_actual_use
checks.finding: The ordinary async application awaits every owned event bank, cancels unselected waits through select/select3 and consumes retained events. L012 uses GTIM3/GTIM4/ATIM, groups both handlers on GTIM34, and calls embassy_time::Timer::after_millis and Instant::now while all owners remain alive. The L012 chip feature enables the optional pinned time dependency and reserves GTIM1; no reserved GTIM1 token is used.

checks.name: native_examples_actual_use
checks.finding: Build source emits six distinct canonical GPIO wrappers from qualified CAPnA/B routes and a separate CH1A/CH1B QEI constructor. Polling capture configures/enables all six halves and disables each selected half before CCR/F/E acquisition and independent clears. QEI observes native count/direction/OVF/UNDF without signed accumulation. No stimulus generation, direct timer PAC access, capture IRQ or DMA is added.

checks.name: examples_features_and_delivery_boundary
checks.finding: Manifests align with the frozen representative families, use the existing pinned Embassy revision, and declare ordinary release firmware. Both scripts emit all regions from exactly one selected memory map without enlargement. F003 QEI can reserve its sole GTIM through the matrix feature while using ATIM only. Type/link fit and generated data remain for the planned main/clean commands; source inspection is not an executed demonstration.

checks.name: documentation_contract
checks.finding: Installed timer-event-input documentation equals the reviewed candidate. API names, accepted native prescalers/filter encodings, coalescence and capture races, EN-independent shutdown, QEI initialization observation gap, strict TCLK pulse-width conditions and absent electrical/silicon guarantees match actual source. Main16/27 and clean2/6 counts are explicitly pending plans.

checks.name: actual_main_completion
checks.finding: All frozen 43 rows have actual successful Cargo completion and retained primary artifacts: 16 ARM rlibs and 27 ordinary linked firmware ELFs. Initial failed M24 is retained separately; total44 command attempts.

checks.name: actual_feature_cfg_and_type_evidence
checks.finding: Actual HAL compiler feature tuples match intended row closures. Generated GTIM/ATIM admission and exact IRQ associations match the static design, and native capture/QEI example constructors were type-checked in actual linked firmware on their frozen representatives.

checks.name: reserved_and_shared_vector_evidence
checks.finding: M15 omits public GTIM, M16 omits public GTIM1 while retaining ATIM, M23 omits GTIM1 and emits distinct GTIM3/GTIM4 handlers on GTIM34 with a live GTIM1 time-driver vector, and M29 omits F003 GTIM while native ATIM QEI links. Required IRQ vector words match strong non-default symbols.

checks.name: baseline_diagnostics
checks.finding: Only three pre-existing generated RCC dead_code constants recur on M11/M12/M16/M22/M40: 15 warning instances, three unique messages. Their unchanged emitter is present in the pre-stage build.rs. No new timer-related warning class or Rust compiler error remains.

checks.name: bounded_build_evidence
checks.finding: Archive ARM executable objects, linked ELF memory fit and actual vector identities establish compilation/link integration only. Cargo freshness is recorded per artifact rather than treated as proof of recompilation. No firmware or hardware behavior has been executed.
